mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM conversation_memory_summary s JOIN conversation c ON c.id = s.conversation_id WHERE s.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.covered_until_turn_id DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_memory_summary ( conversation_id, covered_from_turn_id, covered_until_turn_id, content, model_provider_key, model_name, input_tokens, output_tokens) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, 1, #{turnId}, #{content}, #{providerKey}, #{modelName}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content = VALUES(content), model_provider_key = VALUES(model_provider_key), model_name = VALUES(model_name), input_tokens = VALUES(input_tokens), output_tokens = VALUES(output_tokens)
